what: Rendered levels of every effect voice and of the music pad, from scripts/measure-mix.js run in Chromium (OfflineAudioContext, 48 kHz mono). The battery runs in node and cannot render audio; this file is what the instrument printed, and the instrument is in the tree so the figures can be re-run and audited.
units: dBFS. u unweighted RMS; a A-weighted (IEC 61672); k K-weighted (ITU-R BS.1770). Voices over their sounding samples; the pad over seconds 4 to 14 of a real AudioEngine render.
notMeasured: The bed's pentatonic notes. They are scheduled on the wall clock, which never advances inside an offline render, so neither the pad figures nor any other here include them.
verdict: UNSETTLED. Against the median effect voice the full pad measures about 14 dB OVER unweighted, 4 dB UNDER A-weighted and 10 dB OVER K-weighted. A models the ear at quiet listening levels and discounts a 55 Hz pad by about 30 dB; K discounts it by about 3 dB. Round 7 acted on the unweighted figure (a retune to 0.068), then on the A-weighted one (the revert), and each time chose the model that supported the conclusion in hand. The level stays at the brief's untuned 0.35 until an ear at a real listening level decides.
sourcesNote: sha256 of the two files whose output this record describes. tests/mix-staleness.spec.ts recomputes them and fails on any change, comments included, until the mix is re-measured with the instrument and this record updated.
